endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

request.auth: project-scoped IAM X-Auth-Token, no implicit account fallback

query.fields: Repeated multi query strings, absence/empty source values preserved

response.mapping: Typed complete source schema pagination.Collection[mobilefarm.AvailableDevice]; device serial must match supplied exact ref, lists bind only returned serials to caller project; owner metadata never creates parent
response.numbers: Source integer/number lexical precision retained; protected battery values reveal explicitly
response.status_shape: SmallDevice.status is source Status object, Device.status is source integer; never silently coerce these distinct contracts

errors.mapping: Documented400→invalid_argument,401→unauthenticated,403→permission_denied; bounded shared status errors exclude provider raw fields/messages; malformed response→protocol_error, foreign serial→scope_mismatch

retry: Shared bounded safe reads only; auth/endpoint/cancellation/CallTimeout preserved

pagination.provider: Finite root array, no source page/limit parameters
pagination.local: FixedIterator root-array adapter enforces PageSize/MaxItems/MaxPages/CollectionTimeout; truncation keeps items and incomplete/SDK cursor; body MaxJSONBytes applies
